summary: Build safety leadership metrics, worker consultation, fatigue controls, and ISO 45001 assurance skills. Enrol in practical training.
lede: Safety leadership metrics help HSE, operations, safety, occupational health and HR professionals assess whether controls work and worker input leads to action. The training covers building leading-indicator scorecards, mapping worker consultation, and assessing psychosocial risks and fatigue or workload controls. It also addresses incident analysis, corrective-action verification, and using assurance evidence in management reviews and executive reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must convert occupational health and safety leadership expectations into measurable controls, worker involvement, and credible assurance evidence. This course is designed for: HSE Managers:
audience: Operations Managers: Integrate safety controls into production
Safety Professionals: Analyse incidents, critical controls
Occupational Health Specialists: Assess psychosocial hazards
HR Leaders: Coordinate psychological-health, workload, and fatigue
Frontline Supervisors: Apply safety conversations and verify
Worker Representatives: Present workforce concerns through structured
Contractor Safety Managers: Align contractor assurance evidence
Executive Risk Leaders: Review safety trends, material
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to occupational health and safety activities, operational supervision, HR risk processes, internal auditing, or worker representation. Prior knowledge of ISO 45001 is useful but not required beyond basic awareness. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use provided case data and templates, with Power BI discussed and demonstrated at an operational application level rather than a technical engineering level.
